Subject: Data residency & VPC questions for NordicHealth evaluation

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — our technical and procurement teams reviewed the notes and we have a short list of compliance questions before we proceed to legal review:

- Can you confirm whether customer data (input + generated content) can be restricted to EU-only processing for hosted customers? We need contractual guarantees and technical controls.
- Does Redwood provide an isolated VPC/private deployment option that prevents any egress outside our EU tenancy? If yes, please outline network controls and where logs are stored.
- Please share your latest SOC 2 report, current DPA, and whether you rely on SCCs (standard contractual clauses) or other transfer mechanisms.
- Do you support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) for encryption at rest and in-transit termination in the EU?
- What evidence do you provide for DPIA support and for audits (log retention windows, access to audit trails)?

We need this information to finish our DPIA and to confirm our procurement checklist. If possible, can you send the documents and propose a 30-min call with your security lead (Mikael CISO would like to join) tomorrow afternoon (CEST)?

Best,
Anna

Subject: Re: Data residency & VPC questions for NordicHealth evaluation

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below and I attached the SOC 2 report + a draft DPA v3 for your legal team to review (see attachments).

- EU-only processing: Yes — for our Private (VPC/on-prem) and Dedicated configurations we support guaranteeing processing within EU regions. For Hosted customers we offer region pinning and routing policies; for a contractual guarantee we recommend Private or Dedicated.
- VPC/private deployment: We offer a Private deployment package that runs in your preferred EU region or inside your VPC; network controls include private peering, no public egress by default, and configurable NAT rules. Logs can be kept in-region; more details in the attached network diagram (high-level).
- Contracts / transfers: We provide a DPA (attached) and support SCCs for transfers outside the EEA when needed. We are SOC 2 Type II — report attached.
- Customer-managed keys: Supported. We integrate with major KMS/HSM providers (AWS KMS in EU, Azure Key Vault, customer HSM). Key material can be customer-managed and kept in your EU tenancy.
- DPIA & audits: We provide a DPIA pack and can facilitate an on-site or remote audit; typical log retention is configurable (default 90 days for debug logs, longer for audit logs per contract).

I looped in Olga (security) to add technical details and Laura from legal to coordinate DPA language and DocuSign.

Would 15:00 CEST tomorrow work for a quick call?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Data residency & VPC questions for NordicHealth evaluation

Hi Anna — quick follow-up from security to clarify the technical controls.

1) EU-only processing guarantee:
   - Private deployment: full guarantee — compute, storage, and logs remain in the selected EU region; network egress is controlled by your VPC/NAT configuration.
   - Dedicated: we reserve capacity in EU datacenters and route traffic only through EU endpoints; we provide contractual routing and monitoring.

2) Key management & HSM:
   - We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (EU regions), Azure Key Vault (EU), and customer HSM appliances for on-prem installs.
   - For hosted customers that require BYOK, keys are stored in your KMS; Redwood holds no plaintext key material.

3) Logs, audit, and retention:
   - Audit logs (access, API calls, admin actions) can be retained in-region; default retention is 90 days, extendable by contract to 1+ years.
   - We provide structured audit export (CSV/JSON) and can grant read-only viewer access for auditors.

4) SCCs & transfer mechanisms:
   - We include SCCs as part of the DPA for transfers when needed and can provide a completed SCC Annex.

5) DPIA support:
   - We supply a DPIA template and sample risk assessments used by customers in healthcare; we can identify processing activities, categories of data, and mitigation controls for inclusion in your DPIA.

If you want deeper technical artifacts (packet flow, subnetwork CIDR ranges, firewall rules), we can prepare a redacted network diagram and an implementation runbook under an NDA. I've attached a high-level network architecture diagram to start.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security Architect, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Hi Mikael / Anna — thanks for the detailed questions. A few legal/contractual points:

- We can include language in the DPA that explicitly states processing will be carried out only within the EU for Private and Dedicated deployments. For Hosted region-pinning, we will add a clause describing routing guarantees and monitoring practices; however, for a firm contractual restriction we recommend Private/Dedicated.
- SCCs: we will include the standard SCCs Annex and can provide a completed Annex for your review within 3 business days.
- BYOK / HSM: we support HSM-backed BYOK for both rest and in-transit where the customer requests termination in their tenancy. When TLS is terminated at Redwood-managed endpoints, session keys are ephemeral and not stored long-term; if you require TLS termination inside your VPC, we can include that in the Private deployment runbook.
- Audit rights & DPIA: we can offer audit rights (remote plus on-site subject to scheduling) and will provide the DPIA pack within 5 business days after NDA execution.

I'll upload the DPA to DocuSign for signature and attach a suggested contract clause for EU-only processing for your legal team to review.

Best regards,
